newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Datacraft wins US$1 mln Asia Online deal.
newsitem.headline: Datacraft wins US$1 mln Asia Online deal.

text.p: Datacraft Asia Ltd has secured a US$1 million contract with Asia Online to build its internet infrastructure, the company said in a statement on Wednesday.
Datacraft Hong Kong was awarded the contract to upgrade, enhance and maintain Asia Online's network on a regular basis.
This is follow-up business from the first project in 1995 when Datacraft Hong Hong was chosen to design, supply, install and maintain Asia Online's network.
Asia Online, with its headquarters in Hong Kong, is Asia's largest on-line information service provider.
The company has won similar contracts from internet service providers in Singapore, India, Indonesia and Malaysia.
Singapore-based multinational Datacraft Asia is a leading communications and networking systems integrator and is listed on the main board of the Singapore Stock Exchange.
